mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pmc_alert_log(alert_type, server_id, ref_id, severity, title, message, channel, sent_status) VALUES(#{alertType}, #{serverId}, #{refId}, #{severity}, #{title}, #{message}, COALESCE(#{channel},'WEBHOOK'), COALESCE(#{sentStatus},'SENT'))
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT ON (s.server_id) s.server_id AS "serverId", s.hostname AS "hostname", to_char(a.last_heartbeat, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS "lastHeartbeat" FROM pmc_agent a JOIN pmc_server s ON s.server_id = a.server_id WHERE a.status = 'ACTIVE' AND (a.last_heartbeat IS NULL OR a.last_heartbeat < now() - make_interval(hours => #{hours})) ORDER BY s.server_id, a.last_heartbeat DESC NULLS LAST
SELECT * FROM pmc_alert_log ORDER BY alert_id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
